proved_locally: AES-256-GCM ciphertext does not expose the raw provider handle

moving ciphertext across any bound identity or expiry fails authentication
key rotation can read old ciphertext without relabeling it and writes under the new key

provider or custody-class substitution is rejected
raw handles are bounded printable tokens with no whitespace or control characters
